page.title: Marbella Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise: 2041 Experience

data.meta_description: Book a dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2041 from Puerto Banús. Spot wild dolphins, enjoy a Spanish brunch & cava on a 12.5m Astondoa 40. €749/2h.
data.summary: Experience a dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2041 aboard a 12.5m Astondoa 40 departing Puerto Banús. Includes skipper, brunch, drinks, and a 90% sighting success rate in the Alboran Sea.
key_facts: Boat: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax)
Departs: Puerto Banús, Marbella at 10:00 or 14:00
Inclusions: Licensed skipper, fuel, Spanish brunch, cava, beer, soft drinks
Wild dolphin sightings: common bottlenose & striped dolphins year-round
Best months: April–October for calm seas & higher visibility
Max 9 guests on Astondoa 40 for an intimate experience

faq.q: What is included in the dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2041?
faq.a: The cruise includes a licensed skipper, fuel, a Spanish brunch (fresh bread, Iberian ham, cheese, tomatoes, olives, fruit), cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, water, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% IVA. Just bring sunscreen and a camera.

faq.q: How long is the dolphin watching brunch cruise?
faq.a: We offer a 2-hour cruise for €749 or a 4-hour extended cruise for €1,499. The 2-hour option is ideal for a quick dolphin sighting and brunch. The 4-hour option allows more time to explore the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona.

faq.q: Which boat is used for the dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2041?
faq.a: The standard boat is our Astondoa 40 (12.5m, max 9 guests) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, max 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and are equipped with shaded flybridges, sun pads, and a sound system.

faq.q: What is the best time of year for dolphin watching in Marbella?
faq.a: Dolphins are present year-round in the Alboran Sea, but the best visibility and calmest seas are from April to October. We have a 90% sighting success rate during these months. Winter sightings are also common but seas can be choppier.

faq.q: Can we swim with the dolphins on this cruise?
faq.a: No. We strictly observe wild dolphins from the boat without swimming or feeding. This ensures the animals remain undisturbed and follows Spanish marine wildlife protection guidelines. You’ll get close views as they often bow-ride alongside.

faq.q: What happens if we don't see any dolphins?
faq.a: We have a very high sighting rate (over 90% in season). If no dolphins are spotted, we offer a complimentary 1-hour extension on the same day (subject to availability) or a 50% discount on a future booking. No full refunds.

faq.q: What food is served on the brunch cruise?
faq.a: The brunch includes a selection of Spanish cured meats (jamón ibérico, chorizo), manchego cheese, crusty bread, fresh tomatoes, olives, seasonal fruit, and pastries. Drinks include cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring additional food or drinks. However, our brunch spread is generous and included in the price. Glass bottles are discouraged for safety. A cooler is available on board.

data.body_html:
Combine wild dolphin sightings with a Spanish brunch on the water during a dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2041. Departing from Puerto Banús aboard a 12.5m Astondoa 40 (or Azimut 39), this 2-hour experience lets you spot common bottlenose and striped dolphins in the Alboran Sea while enjoying cava, Iberian ham, and fresh bread. With a 90% sighting success rate from April to October, it’s a reliable, family-friendly way to see marine life up close without leaving the Costa del Sol.

Why Choose the 2041 Dolphin Brunch Cruise?

Unlike crowded catamarans, our dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2041 limits guests to 9–11 people on a private motor yacht. The Astondoa 40’s flybridge gives you a 360° view of the sea, making it easier to spot dolphins from a distance. The skipper knows the local dolphin hotspots around Cabopino and Cala del Faro, and you’ll learn about the marine ecosystem from a licensed professional. Brunch is served on the aft deck or in the saloon, depending on the weather.

What’s Included in the Price

  • Licensed skipper – English and Spanish speaking
  • Fuel – unlimited cruising within the 2-hour zone
  • Spanish brunch – jamón ibérico, manchego, bread, olives, fruit, pastries
  • Drinks – cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, water
  • Light snacks – crisps, nuts, biscuits
  • Insurance & safety equipment – life jackets, first aid, fire extinguisher
  • 21% IVA – all taxes included

The 2-hour cruise costs €749 (up to 9 guests). A 4-hour option is €1,499 for a longer search window and a more relaxed brunch.

Dolphin Species You’ll Likely See

The Alboran Sea is home to several dolphin species. On a typical dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2041, you’ll encounter:

  • Common bottlenose dolphin – grey, up to 3.8m long, often in pods of 10–30
  • Striped dolphin – blue-grey with distinctive stripes, highly acrobatic
  • Short-beaked common dolphin – smaller, with a yellow hourglass pattern (less frequent)

Dolphins often approach the boat to bow-ride, giving you close-up views. Keep your camera ready – the skipper will slow down when dolphins are spotted to maximise photo opportunities.

Best Time to Book

April through October offers the calmest seas and highest visibility. Water temperatures range from 16°C in April to 24°C in August. Morning departures (10:00) tend to have flatter seas and less wind. Afternoon cruises (14:00) can be warmer but still productive. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially in July and August when demand peaks.

Route & Departure Point

All cruises depart from Puerto Banús in Marbella. The route heads south-west towards Cabopino or south-east towards the Marbella Marina shoreline, depending on dolphin activity. You’ll pass the Golden Mile and see La Concha mountain in the background. The skipper may also point out Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés along the way. The boat returns to the same dock after your cruise.

How to Book the Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise Marbella 2041

Booking is simple. Use the WhatsApp number on our site to check availability for your preferred date and time. Payment is via bank transfer or card. We’ll confirm your booking within 2 hours. Cancellation is free up to 48 hours before departure. For more details on all our charters, visit our Marbella boat rental hub.
